text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, here it comes! The special feature on 
Yukino Bijin-chan is starting! Making the 
morning talk show is so awesome.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
They're gonna show exclusive footage here, 
right? Maybe we'll catch a glimpse of an 
angelic private life♪

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
“—And so! Here we are, reporting live from 
Tokyo Racecourse!”

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"Would you look at that—the excitement 
here is like a festival! And the reason 
for it is... —Please take a look at this 
VTR!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
""H-Hello there...! I be Yukino Bijin, by 
gum!""

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"T-Today is the up-close coverage day! I 
look forward to working with you for the 
whole day, pleagh!"

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~! So cute...! An angel...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
""And this adorable young beauty is the 
talk of the town, the 'Snow Angel,' Yukino 
Bijin-san! She's the hot new Umamusume who 
just arrived all the way from Morioka!""

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"And her appeal goes beyond just looks. 
We've obtained exclusive footage of her 
training, so please take a look... at her 
sheer 'grit'!"

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, hold on, did you just say 'pure 
guts'?"

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan did? No way, no way, that 
can't be—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Well then, I'll be off on my usual run!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Deryaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“—Haa... haa... last one! Putting up 350 
kg!”

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fans
text_block_list.text: Three hundred and fifty kilos!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Ngh... Aaaaaaaargh...!"

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Yukino-chan, you're... kinda 
down-to-earth and gritty, huh. I thought 
you'd be more fluffy and delicate.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hmm... ...Or is it trying too hard?

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That was a bit different from what I 
imaginedâ

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawa!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Thank ya very much for all your 
support, y'all!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: "So cuuuute!!!! Do your best~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! It's dangerous, so please don't 
push forward!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Yukino Bijin's popularity is insane. 
She's getting even more popular than 
before~.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It feels a little different from the usual 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The mood's all restless, after all. I just 
hope it doesn't affect "Harp Alpha"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume carrying high expectations on 
the Tiara route. She enjoyed strong, 
dedicated support from regular racing 
fans.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She's a quiet girl, but there's a fire 
inside her. She's got the caliber to win 
even the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I want her to keep winning with that 
sparkling run of hers and become a shining 
star for everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Again...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Must be nice... I wish I could too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right before the race, Yukino Bijin seemed 
a bit off. At first, I thought she was 
just nervous, but...

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Harp Alpha! Wait, let me do a final check 
on your horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text:
How many times does this make today...? I 
told you, I'm totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"No. Your legs are fragile as it is. Not 
even the slightest mistake is permitted... 
You're a girl destined to shine for many 
years to come, after all."

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: ...Why do you believe in me so much?

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"It's because I know your true strength. 
The sheer amount of cheers proves that you 
are a wonderful Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Win, Harp Alpha. Win—and become the star 
of hope for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text:
...Of course it will. Because the one 
shining brightest today will be me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A star... If it's a star, even I...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's gaze as she watched Harp 
Alpha leave. Within it lay an unmistakable 
emotion—a fierce fighting spirit to 
"surpass her."
choice_data_list:
So Yukino doesn't want to lose to her, 
huh.

So Yukino doesn't want to lose to her, 
does she.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, aaah~!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I get it! So that's what this hazy feeling 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I think... this is probably my first 
time doing something like this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I did know, you know? What it means to 
race, and what it means when winners and 
losers are decided.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I see. This bubbling, seething 
emotion inside me...”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I want someone to tell me they want me to 
win. Feelin' like I can do it too... means 
I just don't wanna lose.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I... want to beat her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fierce determination dwells within 
Yukino Bijin's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I can beat her... I feel like something 
will change.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I dunno what that is. An' besides, that 
girl might actually be stronger than me."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Still! Even so, I...!"
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, you have the strength. And 
besides—
It's okay, you have strength. And besides—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Besides?
choice_data_list: I'm always wishing for you to win.
I'm always wishing for you to win.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "I'll definitely win and come back!!"
